distribute_shards: distribute shard indices across jobs so each job gets an approximately equal range of shards
split_gen_kwargs: split generator kwargs into multiple subsets so each job processes a different slice of data source lists
merge_gen_kwargs: merge a list of split generator kwargs dicts back into a single combined kwargs dict
shuffle_gen_kwargs: shuffle all lists in generator kwargs while keeping same-sized lists in synchronized order
count_shards_in_gen_kwargs: count the number of shards from generator kwargs by finding the max length of data source lists
